usedFor: Shopify holds shoppers, and inMobile - SMS gateway stores their numbers through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create or Update Contact” in inMobile - SMS gateway
bestTemplate.why: Each shopper who leaves with a phone number is saved or refreshed in the gateway for later texts.

watchOut: “Add phone number to Blacklist” blocks future texts to that number, so keep it away from triggers like “Order Cancelled”.
